fields.hero_h1: Storefront Glass Repair and Replacement in Toronto and the GTA
fields.hero_subhead: Cracked, smashed, or failed storefront glass? We repair and replace it fast, secure the opening, and keep your business trading. Fully insured, across the GTA.
fields.overview_heading: Storefront glass, repaired or replaced fast
fields.overview_body:
A broken storefront is lost sales and a security risk, so we move fast. SolidGuard repairs and replaces storefront glass across Toronto and the GTA: cracked or smashed panes, failed sealed units, and tempered safety glass cut to size. If the opening needs securing first, we board it up, then return with the glass.

We work around your hours to keep downtime down, and we are fully insured. From a single storefront window to a full shopfront re-glaze, our commercial glass work covers plate glass, tempered safety glass, and aluminum-framed units. Need storefront glass replacement after a break-in or accident? We document the job for your insurer.

faqs.question: My storefront glass is broken. How fast can you come?
faqs.answer: We aim to secure most GTA storefronts the same day. We board up to make the opening safe, then return and fit the replacement glass once it is cut to size.

faqs.question: Do you replace just the glass or the whole frame?
faqs.answer: Usually just the glass. If the aluminum frame is sound we replace the pane or sealed unit in place. We replace framing only when it is damaged.

faqs.question: Tempered or laminated, which should I choose?
faqs.answer: Tempered is the standard storefront option. Laminated holds together when struck, so it is the better choice for security or after repeat break-ins. We will advise for your location.

faqs.question: Can you handle an insurance claim?
faqs.answer: Yes. We document the damage and the work so you have what you need for your insurer, and we can bill where that is set up.

faqs.question: Will you work after hours so we stay open?
faqs.answer: Yes. We schedule around your trading hours to keep downtime to a minimum, and we respond fast to emergencies.

faqs.question: Do you cover the whole GTA?
faqs.answer: Yes, across Toronto and the GTA, fully insured with police-cleared technicians.
